crop.notes: The Allen item is the first paragraph of 'Sporting Notes'; the other two paragraphs (revolver championship, Yale-Princeton and Penn-Harvard football) are unrelated.

ocr.notes: 'Free concert' and 'engaged' are garbled ('ee', 'eng'); otherwise readable.

title.suggested: Tom Allen's Saloon Notice, 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat carried a notice for Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market street, offering a free concert every evening with only the best talent engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, November 21, 1896, page 4.

facts.fact: Allen advertised his place at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, as offering a free concert every evening, styling himself the retired champion pugilist of the world
